title: Three Weeks and One Short Cloth
subtitle: 身体健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）
meta: 主题语境：身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）　|　核心词汇：forehead　|　正文 349 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 forehead 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 the nurse ① bandaged a forehead that no doctor in the ward would have touched, and she said the bandaging was the whole of the afternoon. The ② forehead, meaning the brow itself and not the face, ran three weeks and stayed untouched in the book; a forehead, she said, is the only thing in a ward that is judged by how long it is left untouched.

Every ③ injured forehead in that ward had the same short cloth beside it, and the ④ forehead at the far bed, meaning the one they kept for the child and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A forehead, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to touch; the nurse said the touching is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the forehead was the whole of the matter, meaning the front part and not the brow. The ⑥ forehead, meaning the front part and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody touches; forehead, he said, is either something you bandage or the only word that means both a brow and the front part. He said the front part is the part they remember.

By 1976 the ⑦ forehead had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short cloth. The ⑧ forehead of the whole thing, the nurse wrote in June, was one ward and three weeks of touching; forehead, she said, is either the one at the far bed or the reason you learned to touch. She said the touching was never mentioned.

The ⑨ forehead I remember is the one touched in the plan, which closed in 1978 and is still described as the quietest in the ward. A ⑩ forehead, my mother said in 1980, is the only one that improves by being touched; every forehead, she said, is a front part that has agreed to look like a brow. She said the front part was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 额；前额（指病房里每一处旁边的那一处）
B. n. 前额（指那一处本身，与脸相对）
C. 固定搭配：bandage a forehead 包扎一处前额
D. n. 前额（指留给孩子的那一处）
E. n. 前额（抽象总称，指一间病房的包扎之事）
F. n. 前额（指计划里写到、被触过的那一处）
G. n. 前部；前端（the forehead of a ship，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）
H. n. 前部（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）

items.q: bandaged a forehead that no doctor in the ward would have touched
The forehead, meaning the brow itself and not the face
Every injured forehead in that ward
the forehead at the far bed

The forehead, meaning the front part

The forehead of the whole thing

answers.why: bandage a forehead 意为“包扎一处前额”，1969 年那位护士包扎了一处病房里没有一位医生肯触碰的前额。
forehead 意为“前额”，指那一处本身而不是脸，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被触碰。
forehead 意为“前额”，指病房里每一处旁边的那一处，每一处旁边都有同一块短短的布。
forehead 意为“前额”，指留给孩子的那一处，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
forehead 意为“前部、前端”，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西，叔叔说这个前部就是那件事的全部。
forehead 意为“前部”，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西而不是那一处前额，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
forehead 意为“前额”，指计划里写到、被触过的那一处，到 1976 年这一处成了计划里的一行。
forehead 意为“前额”，护士六月写道，整件事的包扎之事是一间病房和三个星期的触碰。
forehead 意为“前额”，我记得的是计划里被触过的那一处，1978 年结束了，至今仍被说成病房里最安静的一处。
forehead 为抽象总称，母亲 1980 年说，一处前额是唯一会因为被好好触碰而变得更好的东西。
